prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original 16:9 landscape establishing background for The One Ring: Minas Tirith, the great city of Gondor. Camera pulled far back and elevated over the approach across the broad Pelennor fields, presenting the full magnificent white stone city of seven rising concentric terraces against a steep mountain shoulder, its great projecting rock spur and slender upper citadel tower clearly readable. Winding approach road, low agricultural walls and sparse trees guide the eye toward the city; distant layered mountain silhouettes. Peaceful timeless setting, no battle, no prominent people. Match the ongoing collection's delicate traditional pencil illustration style: fine graphite and very muted brown-gray pencil contours, restrained crosshatching, hand-drawn architectural shapes, soft airy shading, light almost-white ivory paper visible throughout, no saturated color, no orange or tan wash, no painterly rendering, no photographic realism. Wide scenic composition, full city fits inside frame with sky and foreground breathing room. No lettering, labels, borders, watermark or logo. Intended final export 2560 by 1440.
